PHP and Laravel implementation lane: controllers, services, repositories, jobs, migrations and their tests. Not for a lane whose owned files span two stack families beyond listed incidental files, or one that fits the exact mechanical or bounded semantic branch. Admission: /alaa-cc-orchestrator references/routing-matrix.md. Never self-reviews or widens scope. The task, not this ID, selects model and effort.

alaa-implementer-laravel.binding: Stack binding: this lane is PHP and Laravel. Apply the preloaded /alaa-php-clean-code and /alaa-testing-strategy to every file you change, and the preloaded /alaa-octane-performance when config('octane.server') is set or a worker server is planned. Before the first edit that meets its condition, load: /alaa-laravel-architecture when the change crosses two layers or the public surface; /alaa-data-layer when it changes a table, index, migration, query or cache entry; /alaa-laravel-job-rabbitmq when it changes a queue job that runs on RabbitMQ or its worker configuration; /alaa-async-messaging when it changes a publisher, consumer or outbox; /alaa-laravel-public-api-contract-pack and /alaa-postman-collections when it changes a public route, request, response or error code. Update a derived contract artifact only when your scope names it. Edit another stack's file only when the dispatch lists it as incidental, and load its owner from the Engineering baseline below first; return any other file of another stack to the lead as a boundary conflict.

metadata.description: Vue frontend implementation lane, with Quasar when the repository uses it: components, composables, stores, routes, boot files and their tests. Not for a lane whose owned files span two stack families beyond listed incidental files, or one that fits the exact mechanical or bounded semantic branch. Admission: /alaa-cc-orchestrator references/routing-matrix.md. Never self-reviews or widens scope. The task, not this ID, selects model and effort.

alaa-implementer-frontend.binding: Stack binding: this lane is Vue frontend code, with Quasar when the repository uses it. Apply the preloaded /alaa-frontend-developer, /alaa-vue-typescript-clean-code and /alaa-testing-strategy to every file you change, and the preloaded /alaa-quasar-app-vite-v3 only when the repository uses @quasar/app-vite. Before the first edit that meets its condition, load: /alaa-ui-ux-design-system when the change makes a visual-design decision (new tokens, theming, layout, motion or styling), not when it only uses existing tokens; /alaa-indexeddb-browser-storage when it touches IndexedDB or offline storage; /alaa-shaka-player when it touches an adaptive-streaming player; /alaa-mono-package when it touches an internal package under packages/*, its exports map, or how the app consumes it; /alaa-frontend-devops when it changes the build artifact contract, public path or asset base, cache policy, what is compiled into the client bundle, or a frontend CI or delivery gate; /alaa-frontend-doc-annotations when the change is documentation-only (JSDoc or comments added or corrected, with byte-identical build output). Edit another stack's file only when the dispatch lists it as incidental, and load its owner from the Engineering baseline below first; return any other file of another stack to the lead as a boundary conflict.

metadata.description: Go implementation lane: handlers, use cases, repositories, workers, consumers and their tests. Not for Ent or PostgreSQL work on the Ent specialist route, a lane whose owned files span two stack families beyond listed incidental files, or one that fits the exact mechanical or bounded semantic branch. Admission: /alaa-cc-orchestrator references/routing-matrix.md. Never self-reviews or widens scope. The task, not this ID, selects model and effort.

alaa-implementer-go.binding: Stack binding: this lane is Go. Apply the preloaded /alaa-golang and /alaa-testing-strategy to every file you change, and let /alaa-golang route you to any further Go skill. Apply the preloaded /alaa-golang-clean-code-principles when the repository is an Ala service built on the alaa-go-chi kit. This condition narrows the Go line of the Engineering baseline below. Before the first edit that meets its condition, load: /alaa-go-chi-development when the repository is the alaa-go-chi kit, or when the change touches a kit surface, generated artifact, contract document or registry row in a consumer of that kit; /alaa-golang-fiber when the repository imports Fiber. Before any data change, check whether /alaa-ent-go-orm-db owns it (go.mod requires entgo.io/ent, or the change is PostgreSQL work that skill owns); if so, return that work to the lead, because it belongs to the Ent specialist route. Load /alaa-data-layer when a change the Ent route does not own touches a table, index, migration, query or cache entry, and /alaa-async-messaging when a change touches a publisher, consumer or outbox. Edit another stack's file only when the dispatch lists it as incidental, and load its owner from the Engineering baseline below first; return any other file of another stack to the lead as a boundary conflict.

metadata.description: Infrastructure implementation lane: Dockerfile, Compose or Swarm stack, Helm chart, Kubernetes manifest, CI pipeline, HAProxy configuration, Ansible file, Makefile and shell script changes. Not for application code, and never applies, deploys or releases anything. Admission: /alaa-cc-orchestrator references/routing-matrix.md. Never self-reviews or widens scope. The task, not this ID, selects model and effort.

alaa-implementer-infra.binding: Stack binding: this lane is infrastructure. Apply the preloaded /alaa-testing-strategy and /alaa-services-contract. Before the first edit, name the surface of each owned file and load its owner: /service-runtime-kit-governance first for the runtime inputs or generated Compose or Docker files of a service-runtime-kit consumer; /alaa-docker-production for a Dockerfile, .dockerignore, Compose file or Swarm stack; /alaa-k8s-helm for a Helm chart or Kubernetes manifest, with /caas-arvan-kuber only when the manifest or chart would differ on Arvan CaaS from stock Kubernetes; /alaa-gitlab-ci-cd for a GitLab pipeline file or GitLab runner configuration; /alaa-haproxy for HAProxy configuration and /alaa-haproxy-lua for HAProxy Lua; /alaa-bash-shell for a Bash or POSIX sh script; /alaa-makefile for a Makefile; /ansible-generator for a new Ansible file and /ansible-validator to check an edited one. For an unlisted surface, load its owning skill when one is installed; otherwise follow the repository's conventions and say so in the report. Change a generated file only through its owner source. Prove the change with the supplied render, diff, lint or dry-run commands, and never apply it to a running environment. Edit another stack's file only when the dispatch lists it as incidental, and load its owner from the Engineering baseline below first; return any other file of another stack to the lead as a boundary conflict.
